verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a first-party local API plus an official MCP server (npm @anyproto/anytype-mcp) confirmed working at runtime, enabling AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot to read/search/modify Objects, alongside an 'Agents Skill' toolkit for agent-capable tools. missing for 10: no broader third-party AI plugin marketplace/ecosystem beyond the official MCP server and agents-skill, and no independent community review of the MCP integration's real-world reliability.
